title: Parted curtain
blurb: Two drapes meet under a rod and sweep apart, with a sliver of light between them.

title: The reveal
blurb: A page whose top half lifts away on a soft wave, with the next page showing underneath in pink.

title: The c, drawn open
blurb: A heavy lowercase c whose opening lets out a wedge of pink light, so the mark and the word are one idea.

title: Two pages, mid swap
blurb: Two rounded pages overlap, the pink one sliding in front with a clear gap around it.

title: The stage
blurb: A proscenium arch over a stage line, with the pink spotlight where the page would be.
